issues.title: Test isolation defect - killIdleConnections() terminates all database connections
issues.description: helpers.zig:322 killIdleConnections() executes pg_terminate_backend on ALL idle connections to bpm_test database, not just the current test. This causes non-deterministic connection failures when tests run concurrently. Observed errors: POSTGRES ERROR terminating connection due to administrator command, error.ConnectionFailed. Prevents reliable integration test execution.
issues.recommendation: Refactor killIdleConnections() to only terminate current test connections (via application_name tracking or connection PID tracking), or serialize test execution.

issues.title: Memory leaks in transition.zig error paths
issues.description: DebugAllocator reports memory leaks in src/engine/transition.zig (cloneJsonValueSafe, processNodeEntry) during error scenarios. Observed in TC-EE-10-06.
issues.recommendation: Ensure proper memory cleanup in error paths.
